bead.title: Decouple embedded broker binding from external Kafka startup
bead.description: PROBLEM: external-Kafka deployments still follow the embedded-broker binding path, so startup tries to bind the broker endpoint even when only an external bootstrap should be configured. ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-server/src/main.rs:73` couples startup wiring to `fjord.listen`, so the runtime uses the same endpoint for broker binding and Kafka producer bootstrap. PROPOSED FIX: update startup wiring so embedded mode binds its own internal broker address while external-Kafka mode only configures `kafka.bootstrap`, never binding the external broker endpoint. NON-SCOPE: topic encoding, wire-format serialization, batching changes, startup sleep cleanup.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestExternalKafkaModeSkipsBrokerBind` proves external-Kafka mode configures producer bootstrap without attempting to bind the broker endpoint.
2. `TestEmbeddedBrokerStillBindsItsOwnAddress` proves embedded mode continues to bind its own internal broker address.
3. `TestRuntimeUsesKafkaBootstrapIndependently` proves startup consumes `kafka.bootstrap` without deriving it from `fjord.listen`.
4. `go test ./crates/pqueue-server/...` passes for the startup wiring path and its callers.
5. `lefthook run pre-commit` passes with the runtime wiring changes and tests.
